text: Weaning is a major stress point for piglets. Provide a heat source at night during the first week after weaning, since they lose the sow's body warmth. Many small pens work better than a few big ones — grouping weaned piglets in homogeneous batches (similar size) avoids harmful fighting and rivalry over food and water that would otherwise leave the smallest piglets progressively weaker. Provide enough nipples and feeder length to prevent competition. Floors should be slatted to prevent dirt and humidity buildup, which favors E. coli. A good pen size is about 2 piglets per square meter.
